Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7147 of 2023

Petitioner :- Kamta Shukla
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.
And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Rajneesh Kumar,Ashok Kumar Yadava

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned AGA for State-respondents.

2. This writ petition has been filed with the following main prayers:-
"(I) issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari thereby quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 31-07-2021 lodged by complainant at P.S.-Krishnagar, Lucknow South, Police Commissionerate, Lucknow against the petitioner and others, at F.I.R. No. 319 of 2021, under section under section 420, 467,
468, 471 I.P.C. as contained in Annexure No. P-1 to this writ petition.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
(II)issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite party No. 3 to not adopt coercive measure against the petitioners in connection with First Information Report dated 31-07-2021 lodged by complainant at P.S.-Krishnagar, Lucknow South, Police Commissionerate, Lucknow against the petitioner and others, at F.I.R. No. 319 of 2021, under section under section 420, 467,
468, 471 I.P.C."
3.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the impugned FIR showing him to be an employee of one Private Company which was involved in supplying electricity meters that have been seized by the Officer of Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. (MVVNL) posted at 33/11 K.V. Substation Sarosa Mohaan Road, Police Station Krishnagar, Lucknow.

The petitioner has no connection at all with either the Project Manager of M/s Bajaj Electrical Shri Divyakant Mohrana or with alleged fraudulent connections issued to 14 persons for extraneous consideration.
4. This Court has carefully perused the impugned F.I.R. and finds cognizable offence is made out against the petitioner.

Whether the petitioner is or is not the employee of the company concerned which had supplied electricity meters meant for district Raebareilly/Unnao/Hardoi to the fraudsters/ main accused for being set-up in the residences of the 14 persons, mentioned in the FIR,
has to been seen after evidence is evaluated by the trial Court.
5. This Court is of the opinion that no case is made out to show interference as prayed in this petition.
The Writ Petition is, accordingly, dismissed at the initial stage itself.
(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra, J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023
